name: SilphScope-Network
description: Send your current character (map position + party, plus a choice of 45 trainer looks -- every class, gym leader, Elite Four member, rival stage and Prof. Oak) to a shared file that lives outside any save, and by default also to a small server (optionally password-gated to a private pool) so other players can find it too -- turn on OFFLINE MODE to keep a save local-only. Other saves find your sent character standing where you left them: it spots you and forces a battle, or you can walk up and interact with it yourself, with optional dialogue you wrote. Beating a ghost pays out a slice of the sender's money, minted for the winner. Once beaten, interact with it to hear its after-battle line again (or fight again if repeatable battles are on). Test build.
